description: Connect the user's HashScraper account in the browser (device login, free sign-up included). Use it first when another HashScraper tool says "Not connected", or when the user asks to connect or reconnect. It never blocks for minutes: the first call returns a link and a code to SHOW THE USER; after the user approves in the browser, call login again to finish and save the key. The key is never shown. Skip it if HASHSCRAPER_API_KEY is set.

restart.description: Throw away a waiting login and start a new link.

name: login
title: Connect HashScraper account
